data_visualization.charts: Use Recharts with transparent backgrounds. Stroke/Fill colors should be #C6F24E for positive/primary, and white/20 for secondary. Hide grid lines entirely or make them ultra-faint (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)). Remove axis lines.
data_visualization.kpi_values: Use JetBrains Mono, weight 300, huge sizes (text-5xl or text-6xl) for dollar amounts or critical metrics.

status_indicators.safe: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
status_indicators.warning: bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
status_indicators.fraud: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

motion.page_transition: Framer Motion: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10}, animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}, transition={duration: 0.4}

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Fonts: Include `<link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@100,200,300,400,500,700,800,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">` in index.html, alongside Google Fonts for 'Manrope' and 'JetBrains Mono'.
Tailwind Config: Map the colors accurately in tailwind.config.js (background: #0B0B0D, primary: #C6F24E, surface: #151518). Set font families correspondingly.
Data-TestID: ALWAYS include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, table rows) as per testing requirements.

Layout Approach: Create a split panel layout as requested. One side should feature a dense dark list, and the other side should pop with a contrasting pure white (#FFFFFF) detail card for dramatic effect.

No Generic Cards: Do NOT use standard Shadcn card styles. Implement the 24px heavily rounded corners with 1px subtle white/5 borders and deep #151518 backgrounds explicitly to ensure the 'premium fintech' aesthetic.
KPI Values: Ensure that numerical data (dollars, percentages) uses the JetBrains Mono font at a very light weight (font-light or 300) to match the reference style.
Lucide Icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (e.g. strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the elegant typography.
Top Navigation: Implement the rounded pill top nav fixed at the top center of the screen, styled exactly as defined in the components.navigation spec.
